s1.title: Where every day is Veterans Day.
s1.intro: We're a family of veterans, their loved ones and neighbors. Together we honor those who served, stand by today's military families and give back to the town we call home.
s1.photo_credit: The Flag Memorial at the Vets Hall · Photo: Jay Burbank

s3.heading: A close-knit family, serving a close-knit town
s3.text:
Here in Cambria, the word “family” means something special. Post 432 is a group of men and women who come together to honor and serve our veterans, support our community and look out for one another. Because Cambria is a small and somewhat isolated town, we believe in taking care of each other — we work together, share meals, celebrate together and lend a hand whenever it's needed.

When you join us, you may find you receive far more than you give: wonderful people, inspiring speakers, a chance to cook, bake or barbecue, to support local kids, and to make a real difference right here at home.

s7.heading: There's a place here for the whole family
s7.text: Three organizations, one mission. Together they make up the American Legion Family in Cambria.

box_1.heading: The American Legion · Post 432
box_1.text: For veterans who served at least one day of active duty since December 7, 1941.

box_2.heading: Sons of The American Legion · Squadron 432
box_2.text: For sons, grandsons and other male descendants of Legionnaires and eligible veterans.

box_3.heading: American Legion Auxiliary · Unit 432
box_3.text: “Service, Not Self.” Supporting veterans, military families and our community.

s8.heading: Served at least one day of active duty since 1941?
s8.text: You're eligible for The American Legion — and we'd love to welcome you to Post 432.

box_1.heading: Help us help local veterans
box_1.text:
Your gift supports Troop Support Services, scholarships, the Veterans Memorial and community events like the Picnic in the Park.

American Legion Post 432
P.O. Box 697, Cambria, CA 93428-0697
